tooltip.wuxingxiantu.formation.sword: One of the four Zhuxian swords. Collect all four and use their chart to deploy the formation.
tooltip.wuxingxiantu.formation.chart: With all four swords in your inventory, use the chart on the ground to deploy. Use it again to close.
tooltip.wuxingxiantu.formation.cost: First payment after 12 seconds, then every 60 seconds: %s low-grade value (5 exquisite stones). Closes when unfunded.
tooltip.wuxingxiantu.formation.no_combat: The swords and dome are a formation display, with no direct damage, collision barrier or damage reduction.
message.wuxingxiantu.formation.opened: Deploying the Zhuxian Sword Formation. The first payment is due after 12 seconds.
message.wuxingxiantu.formation.need_swor: Deployment requires all four Zhuxian swords, with permission to use each one.
message.wuxingxiantu.formation.need_ston: Requires 3645 low-grade value (5 exquisite stones). The first payment is charged when deployment completes.
message.wuxingxiantu.formation.empty: Insufficient spirit-stone value. Zhuxian Sword Formation closed.
tooltip.wuxingxiantu.formation.poem.3: Forged without reversing yin and yang,
tooltip.wuxingxiantu.formation.poem.4: Yet water and flame still tempered the edge.
tooltip.wuxingxiantu.formation.poem.6: Xianxian fills all quarters with crimson light;
tooltip.wuxingxiantu.formation.poem.8: Even great immortals stain their robes with blood.
